initialFailure: The first Restore helper passed a custom-relative index to RemoveCustomSize, which expects a combined index. Removal failed and the unbounded while loop repeatedly logged the error; the Editor was stopped.
recovery: Reopened saved clean Reference; restored the untouched original preference backup and all seven original preset names, types, dimensions and index 0.
finalHelper: One bounded descending traversal skips built-ins and all original custom indices, removes only the owned temporary name/type/dimension combinations, verifies each decrement, and restores background settings in finally.
productionImpact: No production state or scene changes. This was not an established audio deadlock.
